title: 第207章 侵入六千贡献点相聚第206章 炼丹赔礼道歉
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：兽鼎仙途第207章侵入？六千贡献点，相聚。（..la）赖炜和赖清欢答应调解的事情，顾景元自然是不知道的。
这个事情他原本也没当一回事。
毕竟他如今一心扑在修炼之上，很快便将这事情抛之脑后了。
此刻炼丹堂的火室之中，顾景元正在不知疲倦地炼制丹药。
而另一边，观月崖外，
董戈和董松越来到这边，两人暗中遮掩气息身形。
董戈开口：“确定了吗？”
闻言，董松越点头，道：“确定了，赖沐确实接了炼丹任务，此刻已经在炼丹堂火室之中闭关了快一个月了。”
董戈：“好，你望风，我潜入进去采摘灵药。”
“好。”
董松越点头。
董戈潜入观月崖旁边，随即拿出一块玉符，这是一块特殊的玉符，可打开一次观月崖的守护大阵。
这玉符是董松越想办法从另一位修缮洞府阵法的长老那边得到的，就是为了今日。
只要趁着赖沐不在，暗中打开守护阵法，采摘灵药离去，那一切都神不知鬼不觉。
随着玉符激活，观月崖的守护阵法慢慢地被打开一口洞口。
董戈眼神一亮，随即走入进去。
只是下一刻，阵法爆发道道刺目的七彩光芒，顾景元提前留下的声音响彻这方天地。
“何人胆敢闯我洞府！”
同时，内部阵法开始变幻，汲取外部阵法之力，形成另一层的保护阵法。
“不好！”

董戈脸色剧变。
这一变故要是被人发现，上报执法队，他们可就死定了。
毕竟暗中潜入其他人的修炼洞府，这可是大忌。
没有人能容忍。
他们有再多关系，也没有人敢替他们说话。
“快跑。”
董戈瞬间出现在外面，叫上董松越跑。
其实不用他开口，董松越已经在跑了。
这边的动静很大，也有人发现，但董戈没有继续强闯，所以这动静没有持续太久，慢慢地平息了，也就没人在意了。
董戈和董松越这边，两人一脸后怕。
好一会后，董戈才咬牙切齿地开口道：“这该死的赖沐，他早有准备，增加新的守护阵法。不对，他是不是发现那两株灵药了？”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 207 of Beast Cauldron: Invasion? Six thousand contribution points, get together. (..la) Gu Jingyuan naturally didn't know about Lai Wei and Lai Qinghuan's agreement to mediate.
He didn't take this matter seriously at first.
After all, he was now focused on cultivation and quickly put this matter behind him.
At this moment, in the fire room of the alchemy hall, Gu Jingyuan was refining the elixir tirelessly.
On the other side, outside Guanyue Cliff,
Dong Ge and Dong Songyue came here, and they secretly covered their auras and figures.
Dong Ge said: "Are you sure?"
Hearing this, Dong Songyue nodded and said: "It's confirmed, Lai Mu has indeed taken over the alchemy task. He has been in seclusion in the fire room of the alchemy hall for almost a month now."
Dong Ge: "Okay, you look out for the wind, and I'll sneak in and pick the elixir."
"Okay."
Dong Songyue nodded.
Dong Ge sneaked into Guanyue Cliff and immediately took out a jade talisman. This was a special jade talisman that could open the guardian formation of Guanyue Cliff.
Dong Songyue tried his best to get this jade talisman from another elder who was repairing the cave formation, just for today.
As long as Lai Mu is away, secretly open the protective formation, pick up the elixir and leave, everything will be done without anyone noticing.
As the jade talisman was activated, a hole was slowly opened in Guanyue Cliff's protective formation.
Dong Ge's eyes lit up and he walked in immediately.
But the next moment, the formation erupted with dazzling colorful lights, and the voice left by Gu Jingyuan in advance resounded throughout the world.
"Who dares to break into my cave!"
At the same time, the internal formation began to change, absorbing the power of the external formation to form another layer of protective formation.
"Not good!"
Dong Ge's expression changed drastically.
If this incident were discovered and reported to the law enforcement team, they would be dead.
After all, it is taboo to sneak into other people's training caves secretly.
No one tolerates it.
No matter how many connections they have, no one dares to speak for them.
"Run quickly."
Dong Ge suddenly appeared outside and called Dong Song to run away.
In fact, Dong Songyue was already running without him opening his mouth.
There was a lot of movement here, and some people noticed it, but Dong Ge didn't continue to force his way in, so the movement didn't last for long. It slowly subsided and no one cared.
Dong Ge and Dong Songyue looked scared.
After a while, Dong Ge gritted his teeth and said, "Damn Lai Mu, he has already prepared to add a new protective formation. No, did he discover those two elixirs?"
